ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector of side $AB$, $OM$, and the perpendicular bisector of side $AC$, $ON$, intersect at point $O$. These two perpendicular bisectors intersect $BC$ at points $D$ and $E$, respectively. It is known that the perimeter of $\triangle ADE$ is $7\,\text{cm}$. The lines $OA$, $OB$, and $OC$ are drawn. If the perimeter of $\triangle OBC$ is $15\,\text{cm}$, find the length of $OA$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OA, OB, OC,\\
$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle ADE$ is $7\,\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore$ $AD+DE+EA=7\,\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore$ $BC=DB+DE+EC=AD+DE+EA=7\,\text{cm}$;\\
$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle OBC$ is $15$,\\
$\therefore$ $OB+OC+BC=15$,\\
$\because$ $BC=7$,\\
$\therefore$ $OB+OC=8$,\\
$\because$ $OM$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$,\\
$\therefore$ $OA=OB$,\\
Similarly, $OA=OC$,\\
$\therefore$ $OA=OB=OC=\boxed{4\,\text{cm}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, with A above, and B and C at the two ends of the same horizontal base BC. D and E are located on BC, in the order B-D-E-C. The left line OM perpendicularly bisects AB, intersects AB at M, and intersects BC at D; the right line ON perpendicularly bisects AC, intersects AC at N, and intersects BC at E. The two perpendicular bisectors intersect at O, and OA, OB, and OC are also drawn in the figure. Reasoning: Because D is on the perpendicular bisector OM of AB, AD = DB. Because E is on the perpendicular bisector ON of AC, AE = EC. It is known that the perimeter of triangle ADE is 7 cm, that is, AD + DE + AE = 7. From AD = DB and AE = EC, we can get DB + DE + EC = AD + DE + AE = 7, and DB + DE + EC is exactly equal to BC, so BC = 7 cm. It is also known that the perimeter of triangle OBC is 15 cm, so OB + OC + BC = 15. Substituting BC = 7 gives OB + OC = 8. Because O is on the perpendicular bisector of AB, OA = OB; because O is on the perpendicular bisector of AC, OA = OC. Therefore OB = OC = OA, so OB + OC = 2OA = 8, and solving gives OA = 4 cm.
